newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan centenarian twin draws smiles with poll quip.
newsitem.headline: Japan centenarian twin draws smiles with poll quip.

text.p: Kin and Gin, Japan's celebrity centenarian twins who have lived through all but one of the country's 41 parliamentary elections, were not telling who they voted for on Sunday.
But in a general election marked by voter apathy and a record low turnout, Kin supplied the quote of the campaign when asked how she had cast her vote.
"I forget," she replied after voting in the central Japanese city of Nagoya.
The two 104-year-old twin sisters, born in 1892, two years after Japan's first parliamentary election, have become celebrities through their regular appearances in television commercials.
